The Malice handler (AscensionFelswornEvents.cpp:97-98, :227-229) casts 802678 on the target after an outgoing direct (not periodic) critical damage event that passes Chance() on the raw ProcChance 60 (AscensionFelsworn.cpp:231-239), which no spell modifier forces; a stack or refresh of the same caster's 802678 goes through ModStackAmount then OnAuraApply (Unit.cpp:5465-5466). Feed: Azzinoth's Assault 803475 (the level 60 rank, GCD 1000 ms, needs 803468 and 2 Felfury per cast) at the dummy every 1100 ms; its two strikes 520262 and 572585 (melee, not Derived, AscensionFelsworn.cpp:61-69) are direct hits, made critical by the melee crit rating fixture; the class file's hit and expertise ratings remove misses, dodges and parries. Fixtures named as preconditions: Felfury 800058 x6 and 803468 set before the casts and Felfury set to 6 again after every feed cast (refeed). Control: the same five casts before 800214 is learned read 0 stacks. Treatment: 4 trials of five casts each (stack_feed), each valid with at least 4 counted applications whose poll spans stay under 6000 ms; a valid trial passes at exactly 3 stacks, never 4. Design arithmetic only (not the residual): 10 strikes at 60% leave fewer than 4 applications in 5.5% of trials if every strike crits and lands; measured on the pair prove1 (build 100257c26805, 2026-11-23): v = 0/4 trials void in both runs, so N = 4 and v^N = 0 (at most 0.05%); 1.40 and 1.00 applications per feed cast in the valid trials (per cast, not per hit: the scenario reads no hit count).
